suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy on a Thursday night that didn't need a rollback, so I actually got to sleep.
I'm thankful for the rain starting the second I duck under the LRT overhang instead of five minutes earlier.
I'm grateful for a stack trace that pointed straight at the real bug instead of sending me on a two-hour goose chase.
I'm thankful for my dad texting 'dah makan?' even though I'm clearly old enough to feed myself.
I'm grateful for the quiet fifteen minutes before Fajr when the whole house is still asleep and it's just me and a cup of coffee.
I'm thankful for a teammate who caught my off-by-one error in review instead of letting it slip into prod.
I'm grateful for the air-cond finally kicking in on a bus that smelled like it hadn't worked in years.
I'm thankful for a landlord who fixed the leaking pipe the same day instead of the usual two-week runaround.
I'm grateful for finding a parking spot right outside the surau on a Friday when I was already running late.
I'm thankful for my grandmother still remembering exactly which curry is my favourite after all these years.
I'm grateful for a merge conflict that resolved itself cleanly instead of turning into an afternoon of git archaeology.
I'm thankful for the kopitiam uncle topping up my kopi without asking, because he already knows the order.
I'm grateful for a strong Wi-Fi signal at 2am when I'm debugging something that could've honestly waited till morning.
I'm thankful for a raise that landed without me having to ask twice, right when rent went up.
I'm grateful for a Sunday with genuinely nothing on the calendar, not even the guilt about it.
